WITH manager_awards AS (
  SELECT 
    ma.player_id,
    p.death_country,
    COUNT(*) as award_count
  FROM manager_award ma
  JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country
),
country_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    death_country,
    SUM(award_count) as country_total
  FROM manager_awards
  GROUP BY death_country
)
SELECT 
  ma.player_id,
  ma.death_country,
  ma.award_count,
  ma.award_count::float / ct.country_total as share
FROM manager_awards ma
JOIN country_totals ct ON ma.death_country = ct.death_country
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10
